title: The Contest Contract — submission frontmatter
description: v1.0. YAML frontmatter contract for contests/{id}/submissions/*.md files. Validates the file→contestant join key plus the snapshot pinning. The verbatim body (Portfolio Name · Thesis · Holdings · Risk Ack · Construction Memo · Self-ID) is parsed by the loader against the submission-body shape documented in CONTRACT.md §7 — not by this schema. See CONTRACT.md §7.

contestant_id.description: The bare contestant-id this submission is from (claude, chatgpt, …). REQUIRED. This is the file→contestant join; the loader never infers the contestant from the filename. Must reference an id present in contestants.yaml (runtime-validated).

version.description: Normalized display snapshot of the version that competed in this contest ("Opus 4.8", "3 Pro"). REQUIRED. Pins what version this submission represents — the lineage row in contestants.yaml is stable across versions.

model_string.description: Forensic API model id ("claude-opus-4-8"). REQUIRED. For an LLM, the exact API string. For a SaaS product, the product version string. For any kind, whatever uniquely pins the snapshot.

reasoning_time.description: Wall-clock time the contestant spent reasoning. Optional — null if not captured or not applicable.

contestant.description: Display name. Descriptive duplicate of the registry value — present for human readers; the loader takes contestants.yaml as authoritative.

maker.description: Organization that owns the lineage. Descriptive duplicate of the registry value.

access_surface.description: Where the contestant was being used for THIS contest. Per-contest override of contestants.yaml's default_access_surface (LLM kind) or default equivalent (other kinds).

configuration.description: The mode/tools active for THIS contest ("Extended thinking + Web search"). Per-contest override of the registry default.

submitted_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp the submission was received from the contestant. Receipt — establishes the host's possession time.

host.description: The hosting entity. "Promptwire" for The AI Open contests.
